verdict.rationale: Letta's Agent SDK exposes a wide range of core UI capabilities via API — creating/resuming agents, sending/streaming messages, memory management, MCP tools, permissions, deployment backends, and session resume (letta-docs-1,42,59,77,46,44,61) — suggesting strong UI/API parity for the core chat-agent workflow. However, a probe for a public OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s (letta-probe-2), and several UI-surfaced features (teleportation, Slack integration, scheduled tasks, org collaborators/sharing permissions) are documented only as platform/UI features without evidence they are exposed through the Agent SDK API (letta-docs-81,52,69,97,98). missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference confirming full endpoint parity, and explicit API access to teleportation, Slack, scheduling, and team-permission features.
